request.prompt: Paint a new Age of Empires III unit portrait in exactly the painting style of the first two reference images (official Age of Empires III unit portraits): close-up of head and shoulders, the head large in the upper half, three-quarter view, smooth airbrushed painterly skin, simplified stylised forms and folds, soft warm key light, hand-painted video-game look, NOT a photograph. He wears a Korean steel helmet (tugu) with a rounded bowl, a tall spike with a red horsehair plume on top and a mail neck guard; a studded cloth armour coat (dujeong-gap) covered with rows of round brass studs, with black edging; red sleeves. He holds a long spear upright beside him (steel blade, red tassel below the blade, dark wooden shaft). Background: flat pure green (#00FF00), nothing else. No text, no border.
